name: PokéFind
description:
Join thousands of Trainers on our New Server, PokeFind! PokeFind is a combination of Pokemon Games and some Pokemon Go Mechanics! The best part is that we are COMPLETELY VANILLA! Yup, that’s right.. NO MODS! All you have to do is type in play.pokefind.co and play! Here are some awesome features we have:

[-] POKEMON WORLD

[-] POKEMON SURVIVAL

[-] COMPETITIVE BATTLING

[-] CUSTOM STORYLINE

[-] A GREAT COMMUNITY

[-] CONSTANT YOUTUBERS
